[IMAGE: original.jpeg]
### 1. Transcription of Text

#### Header (Top Area)
* **Top Left Emblem Text:** 
  ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ప్రభుత్వం (Andhra Pradesh Government)
  ANDHRA PRADESH
* **Top Right Emblem Text:** 
  ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ప్రభుత్వం (Andhra Pradesh Government)
  ANDHRA PRADESH
* **Telugu Title (Center Top):** 
  ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ప్రభుత్వం
  గ్రామ-వార్డు సచివాలయ శాఖ
* **Top Right Identification Codes:**
  `APGSWS AE 81852715`
  `EIG ONE EIG FIV TWO SVN ONE FIV`

#### Main Titles
* `GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH`
* `INCOME & ASSET CERTIFICATE FOR ECONOMICALLY WEAKER SECTIONS`
* `VALID FOR THE YEAR 2025-2026`

#### Application and Date (Middle Right)
* `Application No`
* `EWS250708074005`
* `Date : 15/07/2025`

#### Certificate Body
* "This is to certify that Shri/Smt./Kumari `KUSUMANCHI YOGENDHAR BHAVANI SHANKAR` son/daughter/wife of `KUSUMANCHI SRIRAMA GUPTHA` permanent resident of `40-1-16/115` village/Street `Gopalapatnam` Post office `Gopalapatnam` District `VISAKHAPATNAM` in the State/ Union Territory `ANDHRA PRADESH` Pin Code `530024` Whose photograph is attested below belongs to Economically Weaker Sections, Since the gross annual income* of his/her 'family'** is below Rs.8 Lakh (Rupees Eight Lakh Only) for the financial year `2024-2025` . His/her family does not own or possess any of the following assets***:"

#### Numbered List of Assets
* `I. 5 acres of agricultural land and above;`
* `II. Residential flat of 1000sq.ft. and above;`
* `III. Residential plot of 100sq.yards and above in notified municipalities;`
* `IV. Residential plot of 200sq.yards and above in areas other than the notified municipalities.`

#### Caste Declaration
* "Shri/Smt./Kumari `KUSUMANCHI YOGENDHAR BHAVANI SHANKAR` belongs to the `OC (ARYA VYSYA)` caste which is not recognized as a Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Other Backward Classes (Central List)."

#### Authority Signature Block (Middle/Lower Right)
* `Signature with seal of Office`
* Handwritten signature: `M. Suvarna Bai`
* `Name : MURALA SUVARNA BAI`
* `Designation : Tahsildar`
* `Mandal : Gopalapatnam`

#### Photograph Box (Lower Left)
* `Recent Passport size photo attached photograph of the applicant`

#### Footnotes
* `*Note : Income covered all the sources i.e salary, agriculture, bussiness, profession,etc.`
* `**Note : The term "Family" for the purpose include the person, who seeks benefits of reservation, his/her parents and sibiling below the age of 18 years also his/her spouse and children below the age of 18 years.`
* `***Note : The property held by a "Family" in different locations or different place/cities have been clubbed by applying the land or property holding test to determine EWS status.`

#### Digital Signature block (Bottom Left)
* `Digitally Signed.`
* `Name: MURALA SUVARNA BAI`
* `Date: 15-Jul-2025 19:12:22`
* `Reason: Approved`
* `GSWS`

#### Bottom Banner and Verification Details
* `Note : This is a Digitally Signed Certificate, does not require physical signature and this certificate can be verified`
* `at https://vswsonline.ap.gov.in/#/home by furnishing the application number mentioned in the Certificate.`
* `ANDHRA PRADESH` (watermarked on lower left and lower right corners)
* `Page 1 of 1` (bottom right corner)

---

### 2. Visual Elements and Spatial Relationships

* **Page Border & Frame:** A light blue outer border frames the entire document. A strip of alternating blue and white upward-pointing triangles runs along the very bottom margin.
* **Emblems:** Two circular, identical green state emblems of Andhra Pradesh sit at the top-left and top-right corners. 
* **Decorative Elements:** 
  * A symmetrical, dark-green line-art flourish divider is placed centrally below the Telugu heading.
  * A similar orange decorative line flourish is positioned at the bottom center, above the footer note.
  * A dark grey circular stamp/holographic seal is located on the left side below the top-left emblem.
* **Codes and Verification Features:**
  * A black-and-white QR code is placed on the middle-left side.
  * A vertical barcode with alphanumeric text underneath is placed on the middle-right side.
* **Applicant Photograph:** A square box in the lower-left contains a grayscale passport-size photo of a young man wearing glasses.
* **Background Watermarks:**
  * A large, faint circular seal watermark is printed in the center background of the certificate.
  * Very faint diagonal parallel lines cover the certificate background area.
  * Faint repeating "ANDHRA PRADESH" watermarks are printed near the bottom corners.

---

### 3. Concept and Process Flow

This document is a formal, digitally signed **Income & Asset Certificate for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)** issued by the Government of Andhra Pradesh. 

The flow of verification depicted by the document:
1. **Identification:** The certificate identifies the applicant (`KUSUMANCHI YOGENDHAR BHAVANI SHANKAR`) along with parentage, address, and caste details.
2. **Eligibility Verification:** It states that the family's gross annual income for the financial year 2024-2025 is below Rs. 8 Lakh and lists the asset-holding limits that the applicant's family does not exceed.
3. **Authentication:**
   * It displays a barcode and QR code for digital validation.
   * It features both a physical signature scan of the Tahsildar (Murala Suvarna Bai) and a digital signature validation timestamp (`15-Jul-2025 19:12:22`).
   * A verification URL (`https://vswsonline.ap.gov.in/#/home`) is provided at the bottom for official validation using the application number.
